method: per-currency pillar drivers -1/0/+1 from the evening engine reads
note: Evening (4pm CT) edition. FX closed Saturday; reads reflect Friday's NY close plus Saturday's geopolitical developments for the Sunday 5pm ET reopen.

currencies.name: US dollar
currencies.summary: Hawkish hold in week four: Dec ~82% priced, claims 197k for a fourth week — Saturday stacked escalation (Riyadh, Trump's flip) against diplomacy (Putin's broker offer); the reopen weights the ledger.

policy.note: Fed hawkish; Dec ~82% priced, Oct ~18% — Saturday changed nothing on the Fed path

growth.note: Claims 197k, 4th straight week near 57-yr lows; consumers gloomier but the Fed watches expectations, not sentiment

inflation.note: U Mich 1y exp 4.7%, 5y 3.5% — rising; diesel deal a mild offset, not a reversal

risk.note: Two-way setup into the reopen: escalation re-armed the haven bid, Putin's broker offer is the counterweight

tot.note: No direct terms-of-trade read for the dollar

positioning.note: USD longs crowded; EUR shorts at 343-report extreme = squeeze risk against the dollar

currencies.name: Euro
currencies.summary: Nothing changed Saturday — ~1.12 holds above 1.1161, fiscal premium still priced in, waiting on Tuesday's budget debate.

fiscal.note: French stress: debt/GDP 119.3%→121.7%, spread ~140–146bp, budget debate Tuesday
